locations.title: The Shard
locations.description:
**Occupied by Radshrews.**
Pre-war, The Shard was a mixed-use tower with hotel space, offices, residences, restaurants, and shops in the lower levels. In Fallout: London, you first enter it by taking the lift up from the Mysterious Lab, the Angel facility where the Wayfarer begins [Broken Angel](https://fallout4map.com/fallout-london?locationIds=606708). 

The front entrance is chained shut on your first visit, so your way out is through [London Bridge Station](https://fallout4map.com/fallout-london?locationIds=390692). From the lobby, look for the black door marked “Underground London Bridge” near the second set of escalators. 

There’s also an optional elevator beneath the lit lion’s head and gold Angel symbol. It leads to an upper hallway with a Novice-locked balcony door and a jammed door that requires Strength 7+ to force open.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Note](https://fallout4map.com/fallout-london?locationIds=606903)**

**Weapons and Apparel:**
- **Makeshift Knife**: In the room sealed off by the jammed door. 
- **Tophat**: On the floor of London’s Outfitters. 
- **Summer Hat**: On the floor of London’s Outfitters. 
- **Formal Hat**: On the floor of London’s Outfitters. 
- **Derby Hat**: On the floor of London’s Outfitters. 
- **Bowler Hat**: On the floor of London’s Outfitters. 
- **Brimup Bowler**: Beside a skeleton on a bench. 

**Chems, Drinks, Food, and Herbs:**
- **Hero**: In the room sealed off by the jammed door. 
- **Rad-X**: In the room sealed off by the jammed door. 
- **Purified Water**: Beside the Shard Concierge Terminal. 
- **Nuka-Cola**: In the room sealed off by the jammed door. 
- **Pre-War Rations x2**: Beside the sink near the Cooking Station. 
- **Moldy Food**: Beside the sink near the Cooking Station. 
- **Clover x2**: Harvestable from the fountain. 

**Valuable Crafting Components:**
- **Oil Canister**: Next to a red telephone booth. 
- **Antique Telephone**: Beside the Shard Concierge Terminal. 
- **Video Camera**: On a shelf at the concierge desk. 
- **Office Desk Fan**: Beside the Shard Concierge Terminal.

locations.title: London Bridge Station
locations.description:
**Occupied by Radshrews.**

London Bridge Station is connected to [The Shard](https://fallout4map.com/fallout-london?locationIds=390696) and is first entered during the prologue quest [Broken Angel](https://fallout4map.com/fallout-london?locationIds=606708). After coming in from The Shard, you’ll pass through the main station area, with a sleeping bag not far from the lift.

There is a lower section called London Bridge Underground Station, reached through a Novice-locked door past the turnstiles near the information booth, below the escalators. This caved-in underground area has extra loot to collect, but no separate exit, so you’ll need to return the way you came.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Protect and Survive](https://fallout4map.com/fallout-london?locationIds=606743)**
- **[Cigarette Card Wild Animal No. 12](https://fallout4map.com/fallout-london?locationIds=606744)**
- **[Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com/fallout-london?locationIds=606709)**
- **Overdue Book x2**: Both on a train in the underground station. 
- **Ticket Stash**: On a train seat in the underground station. 

**Weapons and Apparel:**
- **Pipe Axe**: Under the train advert, beside the lift you first enter from. 
- **Walking Cane**: Beside the skeleton holding Protect and Survive. 
- **High Bowler**: Worn by the skeleton holding Protect and Survive. 
- **Worker Cap**: Beside the skeleton at the information booth. 
- **Brimup Bowler**: Inside a train in the underground station.
 
**Chems, Drinks, Food, and Herbs:**
- **Rad-X**: On a bench in the underground station. 
- **Roid**: On a bench in the underground station. 
- **Jimmy Hat x2**: Both beside the safe inside Booth’s. 
- **Photon Brew**: On the counter inside Ferguson Pub. 
- **Scotch**: On a shelf behind the counter inside Ferguson Pub. 
- **Wine x2**: On a shelf behind the counter inside Ferguson Pub. 
- **Pink Wafers x2**: On a shelf inside the Cake Shop. 
- **Cherry Bakewells x3**: On a shelf inside the Cake Shop. 
- **Tea Bag**: On the counter of the information booth.

**Valuable Crafting Components**: 
- **Cutting Fluid**: On a shelf in the underground station. 
- **Office Desk Fan**: On the counter inside Booth’s. 
- **Aluminum Canister**: Beside a fallen steel beam near the sleeping bag. 
- **Aluminum Can**: Beside a pile of cans inside the Cake Shop.

locations.title: Greenwich Station
locations.description:
**Occupied by a lone Feral Ghoul.**

Greenwich Station is visited during the Vagabonds side quest Swan & Mitre, after “Tricky” Ricky gives you the Greenwich Station Key and asks you to retrieve a Medkit. Inside, the lower levels are sealed off, but the entrance area, upstairs bathroom, shop, and office are accessible. The office contains the quest Medkit, hanging on the wall. 

The station has several small containers and furniture to loot, including an ashtray, two desks, a file cabinet, and a till.

locations.title: Mysterious Lab
locations.description:
**Occupied by Radshrews.**

The Mysterious Lab is where you begin the prologue of Fallout: London and its first main story quest, [Broken Angel](https://fallout4map.com/fallout-london?locationIds=606708). The route through the lab is fairly linear, but there is an easy-to-miss side room near the start. After breaking out of the pod and leaving the starting room, follow the corridor and check the room to your left before continuing onward. Inside, you’ll find a Team FOLON terminal with thank-you messages from the developers. 

Later, after picking up the Torch, the path takes you through another lab area with a Chemistry Station. Before taking the elevator up into [The Shard](https://fallout4map.com/fallout-london?locationIds=390696), you can also find a sleeping bag nearby.

*Note: The Mysterious Lab is located beneath [The Shard](https://fallout4map.com/fallout-london?locationIds=390696). After finishing the prologue, you can return to the lab by re-entering through The Shard.*

**Notable Loot:**
- **[GOG graphic T-Shirt and Trousers](https://fallout4map.com/fallout-london?locationIds=821374)**
- **Utility Belt**: Obtained when you pick up your ATTA-Boy. 
- **Utility Belt Torch**: Picked up after the power goes out.

**Chems, Drinks, Food, and Herbs:**
- **Semi-Skimmed Milk**: In the room with the Team FOLON terminal. 
- **Skimmed Milk**: In the room with the Team FOLON terminal. 
- **Tea Bag x2**: In the room with the Team FOLON terminal. 
- **Sugar**: In the room with the Team FOLON terminal. 
- **Brain Fungus**: On a lab scale beside the Chemistry Station. 

**Valuable Crafting Components:**
- **Aluminum Tray x20+**: Scattered throughout the complex. 
- **Microscope x8**: Scattered throughout the complex. 
- **Bone Cutter x7**: Scattered throughout the complex. 
- **Medical Liquid Nitrogen Dispenser x2**: FOLON terminal room.
- **Mr. Handy Fuel**: In the room you enter after getting the torch. 
- **Aluminum Can**: Beside the blue bins in the room after getting the torch.

locations.title: Swan and Mitre
locations.description:
**Occupied by the Vagabonds.**

The Swan & Mitre is the headquarters of the Vagabonds. Because it is their base, nearly everything inside is marked as owned and must be stolen if you take it. As a pub, it contains a huge amount of alcohol, along with plenty of containers to check, including ammo boxes, fridges, ashtrays, a cigarette machine, filing cabinets, a toolbox, lockbox, first aid kit, medical kits, wardrobe, dresser, dryers, military coolers, and an Advanced-locked safe. 

The pub also has a Cooking Station, Chemistry Station, and an unowned bed upstairs that you can sleep in. Upstairs, you can find Gaunt’s Terminal, which is Expert-locked. It contains logs written by Sebastian Gaunt and can be used to unlock the Advanced-locked safe.
